masters.name: site
masters.label: Site
masters.description: A generating plant: its location, grid connection and design capacity.

masters.name: party
masters.label: Party
masters.description: An organisation the business deals with: manufacturer, supplier, service provider, offtaker or software vendor. Names in the workbook are free text; one party per distinct name.

masters.name: party_role
masters.label: Party role
masters.description: The roles a party plays (OEM, supplier, service provider, offtaker, software vendor).

masters.name: equipment_model
masters.label: Equipment model
masters.description: A manufacturer's product model. Ends the model_id collision: product models live here, forecasting models in ml_model.

masters.name: asset
masters.label: Asset
masters.description: Every physical thing in one hierarchy (site → asset → component). Class-specific attributes live in 1:1 extensions.

masters.name: asset_inverter
masters.label: Inverter configuration
masters.description: Inverter design data, one row per inverter asset.

masters.name: asset_bess
masters.label: BESS configuration
masters.description: One battery storage system: design, specification, operating limits, maintenance intervals, safety and controls, formerly six 1:1 sheets.

columns.name: aux_hvac_k_w_per_container_per_10_c
columns.label: Aux HVAC kW per Container per 10C

masters.name: pv_array
masters.label: PV array
masters.description: A PV array tracked for sustainability (module counts for end-of-life planning), linked to its asset.

masters.name: pv_module_group
masters.label: PV module group
masters.description: A block of PV modules installed together, linked to the PV array asset that holds it.

masters.name: pv_population_segment
masters.label: PV population segment
masters.description: Modules of one model and batch within a group, with their opening balance.

masters.name: pv_module
masters.label: PV module
masters.description: A serialised PV module in its population segment.

masters.name: part
masters.label: Part
masters.description: One part master: the maintenance-spares master, the second spare-parts list and the planning materials (after C11/C12) merge on part code.

masters.name: part_stock
masters.label: Part stock
masters.description: Stock of one part at one site: the ERP/WMS snapshot with its reorder policy, plus the 30-day movement balance where the inventory ledger has one.

masters.name: rate_card
masters.label: Rate
masters.description: Every priced component (labour, equipment, vehicles, services, site mobilisation, part logistics) and every modelled rate or factor, one row each, with unit, currency and validity.

masters.name: crew
masters.label: Crew
masters.description: A maintenance crew and its working-time rules; its rates are on the rate card.

masters.name: technician
masters.label: Technician
masters.description: A technician: crew, home site, skill and working-time rules; pay rates are on the rate card.

masters.name: resource
masters.label: Planning resource
masters.description: A schedulable resource (technician, tool or vehicle) as the planner sees it.

masters.name: vehicle
masters.label: Vehicle
masters.description: A fleet vehicle and its home site (or the regional pool).

masters.name: tool
masters.label: Tool
masters.description: A specialist tool with its calibration state.

masters.name: system
masters.label: System
masters.description: An enterprise system in the landscape (EAM, WFM, fleet, SCADA…).

masters.name: connector
masters.label: Connector
masters.description: A data feed into AIP, registered once (formerly the technology registry and the sustainability connector registry).

masters.name: interface
masters.label: Interface
masters.description: A governed data exchange between two systems.

masters.name: source_document
masters.label: Source document
masters.description: An external standard, regulation or evidence source cited by models and disclosures.

masters.name: metric
masters.label: ESG metric
masters.description: A sustainability metric with its definition, formula and unit.

masters.name: metric_framework_map
masters.label: Metric disclosure mapping
masters.description: Which disclosure in which reporting framework (BRSR, GRI, ISSB, CSRD) a metric serves.

masters.name: ml_model
masters.label: Analytical model
masters.description: A governed forecasting or predictive model: algorithm, training window, validation and approval. AIP's own engines register here too.

masters.name: warranty_contract
masters.label: Warranty
masters.description: A warranty on an asset or a model batch, from the warranty register and the BESS product and performance warranties.

columns.name: retention_pct_eol
columns.label: Guaranteed retention at end of life (%)

masters.name: offtake_contract
masters.label: Offtake contract
masters.description: A power-purchase or storage-capacity contract: counterparty, tariff, capacity, term and obligations. Settlement figures are transactions (phase 3).

masters.name: intervention
masters.label: Intervention
masters.description: One maintenance intervention register: the optimiser's register (with the C9 candidates) and the planning register merge on intervention ID; the PV module interventions exist only in the planning register.

masters.name: scenario
masters.label: Planning scenario
masters.description: One scenario register: the optimiser's portfolio scenarios and the planners' intervention-level simulations.

masters.name: scenario_intervention
masters.label: Scenario line
masters.description: An intervention as evaluated or proposed in a scenario: the optimiser's scores and ranks, and planners' proposed windows.

masters.name: hse_incident
masters.label: HSE incident
masters.description: A health, safety and environment incident in its own ID space, separated from the operational event log.

masters.name: alert
masters.label: Predictive alert
masters.description: A predictive-maintenance alert on an asset: risk score, remaining life and the evidence behind it.

masters.name: recommendation
masters.label: Recommendation
masters.description: A prescriptive action raised from an alert, with the cost of acting now against deferring.

masters.name: work_order
masters.label: Work order
masters.description: A unit of maintenance work on an asset, with its SLA, cost, assignment and preventive-maintenance compliance.

masters.name: event
masters.label: Operational event
masters.description: An operational incident: what happened, where, how severe, and its generation and revenue impact.

masters.name: rca_case
masters.label: Root-cause case
masters.description: A root-cause analysis of an event: the cause found, how it was verified, and its validation.

masters.name: rca_evidence
masters.label: Root-cause evidence
masters.description: A signal observed during a root-cause analysis, compared with its peer baseline.

masters.name: vision_inspection
masters.label: Vision inspection
masters.description: A drone or camera inspection run: coverage, conditions and status.

masters.name: vision_finding
masters.label: Vision finding
masters.description: A defect detected by an inspection, with its confidence, severity and estimated loss.

masters.name: warranty_claim
masters.label: Warranty claim
masters.description: A claim against a warranty: amounts claimed and approved, evidence, deadlines and the OEM's response.

masters.name: pm_plan
masters.label: Preventive maintenance plan
masters.description: A recurring maintenance task on an asset with its frequency, last and next dates.

masters.name: cbm_assessment
masters.label: Condition assessment
masters.description: A condition-based maintenance assessment fusing evidence into a condition, priority and recommended action.

masters.name: condition_evidence
masters.label: Condition evidence
masters.description: One piece of condition evidence (signal, deviation, quality) behind an assessment.

masters.name: part_requirement
masters.label: Part requirement
masters.description: Parts a planned intervention or work order needs, by when.

masters.name: intervention_requirement
masters.label: Intervention requirement
masters.description: A crew, part, tool, vehicle or permit an intervention needs before it can be scheduled.

masters.name: planned_outage
masters.label: Planned outage
masters.description: A scheduled reduction of plant capacity.

masters.name: capacity_test
masters.label: Capacity test
masters.description: A battery capacity and round-trip efficiency test.

masters.name: hse_hours
masters.label: Hours worked
masters.description: Hours worked per site, period and worker type: the denominator of safety rates.

masters.name: ghg_activity
masters.label: GHG activity
masters.description: An emissions activity record (scope, source, quantity) with the factor applied.

masters.name: water_cleaning
masters.label: Module cleaning
masters.description: A module-cleaning event: water used, soiling before and after, energy recovered.

masters.name: execution_feedback
masters.label: Execution feedback
masters.description: How executed work compared with its plan: timing and duration variance, conformance and outcome.

masters.name: forecast_run
masters.label: Forecast run
masters.description: One generation-forecast run per plant and horizon, with its energy totals and quality measures.

masters.name: outcome_validation
masters.label: Outcome validation
masters.description: The value a completed intervention actually realised, against what was predicted.

masters.name: ppa_settlement
masters.label: PPA settlement
masters.description: The current settlement position of an offtake contract: energy scheduled and delivered, penalties, invoices and receivables.

masters.name: plant_telemetry
masters.label: Plant telemetry
masters.description: 15-minute plant measurements: irradiance, temperatures, expected and actual output, losses.

masters.name: inverter_reading
masters.label: Inverter telemetry
masters.description: Per-inverter measurements: DC and AC power, voltage, current, temperature, status and alarms.

masters.name: bess_reading
masters.label: BESS telemetry
masters.description: Battery measurements at the point of interconnection: power, state of charge, temperatures, mode.

masters.name: bess_day
masters.label: BESS daily operations
masters.description: Daily battery energy balance, cycles, availability and temperatures.

masters.name: weather_forecast
masters.label: Weather forecast
masters.description: Numerical weather prediction per plant and interval feeding the generation forecast.

masters.name: forecast_interval
masters.label: Forecast interval
masters.description: The generation forecast per plant and 15-minute interval, step by step through the physics chain.

masters.name: plant_actual
masters.label: Metered output
masters.description: Metered plant output per interval, with observed irradiance, availability and curtailment.

masters.name: forecast_validation
masters.label: Forecast validation
masters.description: Physics and hybrid forecasts against the metered outcome, per run and interval.

masters.name: life_observation
masters.label: Life observation
masters.description: One life record (failure or survival to date) of an asset or a serialised PV module, for reliability models.

masters.name: resource_event
masters.label: Resource calendar event
masters.description: Availability and commitments of technicians, vehicles and tools by day.

masters.name: site_weather
masters.label: Site work-weather forecast
masters.description: Hourly site weather for planning: rain, wind, lightning and the work permissions they allow.

masters.name: record_link
masters.label: Record link
masters.description: One hop of the decision loop between records of different modules (finding → work order, intervention → work order, …).
